units.source_text: 老尼姑听了更是泣不可抑，袖上几乎绞得出泪水来。

en.t: When the old nun heard this, she wept even more uncontrollably, until her sleeves seemed almost wrung full of tears.

units.source_text: 侍从愈加奇怪了，她觉得这样子真难看，一路上喜气洋洋，怎么添了这种怪现象！

en.t: The attendant found it stranger and stranger; she thought such behavior was truly unseemly, and wondered how this odd spectacle had been added to a journey that had been so cheerful all along.

units.source_text: 薰大将听到弁君隐忍不住的啜泣声，自己也偷偷地弹泪。

en.t: General Kaoru heard Ben no Kimi's stifled sobs breaking through, and he too secretly brushed away tears.

units.source_text: 但念浮舟可怜，不知她看了作何感想，便对她说道：

en.t: But thinking how pitiable Ukifune was, and wondering what she might feel on seeing all this, he said to her:

units.source_text: “我因多年以来屡次在这路上往返，今天触景生情，不知不觉地感慨起来。

en.t: For many years I have traveled back and forth along this road, and today the scenery has stirred old feelings in me before I knew it.

units.source_text: 你也稍坐起来，看看这山中景色吧。

en.t: You should sit up a little too and look at the mountain scenery.
These mountains are very deep and secluded.
With that, he almost forced her up into a sitting position.

units.source_text: 浮舟做出恰当的姿势，以扇障面，羞答答地眺望山景，那眉目之间实在非常肖似大女公子。

en.t: Ukifune arranged herself properly, hid her face behind a fan, and shyly gazed out at the mountains; the look of her eyes and brows was truly very much like the elder young lady.

units.source_text: 只是端庄而过分沉着，似觉稍有出入耳。

en.t: Only her dignity and excessive composure seemed to make her slightly different.

units.source_text: 薰大将觉得大女公子一方面像小儿一般天真烂漫，另一方面又用心深远，考虑周至。

en.t: General Kaoru felt that the elder young lady had been, on one side, as innocent and openhearted as a child, and on the other, deeply thoughtful and thoroughly considerate.

units.source_text: 于是他对亡人的悼念之情依旧“充塞天空”，“无处逃”了。

en.t: And so his grief for the dead woman once again filled the sky, leaving him nowhere to escape.
